title: Petitions for My Daughter
lede: Pray them one at a time, by name. Pick a daughter, fill in the names, and print the set.

items.title: Her Identity
items.body: Father, let {{child}} know whose she is before the world tells her what she is worth. Settle her identity in You so deeply that no screen, no comment, no season of comparison can shake it loose.

items.title: Her Worth Beyond Beauty
items.body: Lord, {{child}} will be told a thousand times that her value is her appearance. Give her a gentle and quiet spirit that is unshakeable, and let her know she is lovely without needing the verdict of strangers.

items.title: Her Father's Voice
items.body: Father, I am the first man to define what a man is for {{child}}. Let my voice be warm, steady, and safe. Do not let me provoke her, dismiss her, or go quiet when she needs me to speak.

items.title: Her Courage
items.body: Lord, make {{child}} strong — strong enough to say no, to leave a room, to stand alone. Let her laugh at the days to come because she knows who holds them.

items.title: Her Friendships
items.body: Father, give {{child}} friends who build her up. Guard her from the ones who trade in cruelty and call it honesty. And make her a friend worth having.

items.title: Her Purity and Protection
items.body: Lord, protect {{child}}'s heart and body. Let love not be awakened before its time. Guard her from any man who would take what he has not covenanted to keep.

items.title: Her Mind
items.body: Father, sharpen {{child}}'s mind. Let her think clearly, read widely, and refuse to be squeezed into the shape of her moment. Give her discernment.

items.title: When She Is Anxious
items.body: Lord, meet {{child}} in her anxiety. Where her thoughts run ahead of her, bring peace that outruns her understanding. And let her know she can bring the whole of it to You without cleaning it up first.

items.title: Her Future Husband
items.body: Father, if marriage is Your plan for {{child}}, prepare a man of character for her — and give her the wisdom and the nerve to refuse anything less.

items.title: Her Calling
items.body: Lord, You have placed {{child}} in this moment for a reason. Show her what it is. Let her not shrink from it, and let me never make her smaller to keep her close.

items.title: Her Joy
items.body: Father, give {{child}} joy that is not weather-dependent. Let there be real laughter in our house, and let her carry it out into her own one day.

items.title: That She Would Be His
items.body: Lord, above every other request: bring {{child}} to Yourself and keep her there. Let no one take her out of Your hand.
